```{r helper-functions,include=TRUE,echo = FALSE}
dir <- './HmscOutputs'
pattern <- '2026-02-10'

make_gamma_sizes <- function(dir,pattern){
  pattern2match <- pattern
  
  matching_folders <- list.dirs(dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = F)
  matching_folders <- matching_folders[grepl(pattern2match, basename(matching_folders))]
  model <- matching_folders[1]
  
  outputs <- lapply(matching_folders,function(model){
    # read objects
    gamma <- read_excel(file.path(dir,
                                         model,
                                         'Results',
                                         sprintf('%sparameter_estimates_Gamma_.xlsx',model)),
                        sheet = 'Posterior mean') %>% 
      as.data.frame.data.frame()
    gamma_sigs <- read_excel(file.path(dir,
                                        model,
                                        'Results',
                                        sprintf('%sparameter_estimates_Gamma_.xlsx',model)),
                              sheet = "Pr(x>0)")
    
    load(file.path(dir,
                   model,
                   'Models/Fitted',
                   sprintf('HPC_samples_0250_thin_100_chains_4.Rdata')))
    
    m <- fitted_model$posteriors
    
        # 1. Pivot Effect Sizes to long format
    long_effects <- gamma %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -Traits, names_to = "environmental_variable", values_to = "effect_size") %>%
      rename(traits = Traits)
    
    # 2. Pivot Significance to long format
    long_sigs <- gamma_sigs %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -Traits, names_to = "environmental_variable", values_to = "sig_val") %>%
      rename(traits = Traits)
    
    # 3. Join, Mask, and Merge with your main data
    final_df <- long_effects %>%
      left_join(long_sigs, by = c("traits", "environmental_variable")) %>%
      # Apply the mask: Keep only if sig <= 0.05 OR sig >= 0.95
      mutate(effect_size = ifelse(sig_val > 0.05 & sig_val < 0.95, NA, effect_size)) %>%
      select(-sig_val)
    
    # get atlas 
    atlas_num <- as.numeric(sub(".*Atlas([0-9]+).*", "\\1", model))
    final_df$atlas <- atlas_num
    return(final_df)

  })
  merged <- do.call(rbind,outputs)
  return(merged)
}

make_beta_sizes <- function(dir,pattern){
  pattern2match <- pattern
  
  matching_folders <- list.dirs(dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = F)
  matching_folders <- matching_folders[grepl(pattern2match, basename(matching_folders))]
  model <- matching_folders[1]
  
  outputs <- lapply(matching_folders,function(model){
    # read objects
    gamma <- read_excel(file.path(dir,
                                         model,
                                         'Results',
                                         sprintf('%sparameter_estimates_Beta_.xlsx',model)),
                        sheet = 'Posterior mean') %>% 
      as.data.frame.data.frame()
    gamma_sigs <- read_excel(file.path(dir,
                                        model,
                                        'Results',
                                        sprintf('%sparameter_estimates_Beta_.xlsx',model)),
                              sheet = "Pr(x>0)")
    
    load(file.path(dir,
                   model,
                   'Models/Fitted',
                   sprintf('HPC_samples_0250_thin_100_chains_4.Rdata')))
    
    m <- fitted_model$posteriors
    
        # 1. Pivot Effect Sizes to long format
    long_effects <- gamma %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -Species, names_to = "environmental_variable", values_to = "effect_size") %>%
      rename(species = Species)
    
    # 2. Pivot Significance to long format
    long_sigs <- gamma_sigs %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -Species, names_to = "environmental_variable", values_to = "sig_val") %>%
      rename(species = Species)
    
    # 3. Join, Mask, and Merge with your main data
    final_df <- long_effects %>%
      left_join(long_sigs, by = c("species", "environmental_variable")) %>%
      # Apply the mask: Keep only if sig <= 0.05 OR sig >= 0.95
      mutate(effect_size = ifelse(sig_val > 0.05 & sig_val < 0.95, NA, effect_size)) %>%
      select(-sig_val)
    
    # get atlas 
    atlas_num <- as.numeric(sub(".*Atlas([0-9]+).*", "\\1", model))
    final_df$atlas <- atlas_num
    return(final_df)

  })
  merged <- do.call(rbind,outputs)
  return(merged)
}

plot_venn_grid <- function(data, item_column, target_vars, plot_title, plot_subtitle = NULL, show_items = TRUE, use_percentages = FALSE) {
  
  base_colors <- c(
    "Temperature" = "firebrick3", "Precipitation" = "dodgerblue3",
    "Land-use heterogeneity" = "maroon4", "Urban" = "seashell4",
    "Cropland" = "goldenrod1", "Pasture" = "orange",
    "Forest" = "springgreen4", "Grass/Shrubland" = "palegreen3",
    "Site (Spatial Random Effect)" = "cornsilk2"
  )
  
  # Ensure the data is prepared
  venn_data_all <- data %>%
    filter(environmental_variable != "(Intercept)", !is.na(effect_size)) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = ifelse(effect_size > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
      variable_clean = case_match(environmental_variable,
        "tmean_year"       ~ "Temperature",
        "prec_year"        ~ "Precipitation",
        "hh"               ~ "Land-use heterogeneity",
        "perc_urban"       ~ "Urban",
        "perc_cropland"    ~ "Cropland",
        "perc_pasture"     ~ "Pasture",
        "perc_forest"      ~ "Forest",
        "perc_grass_shrub" ~ "Grass/Shrubland",
        .default = environmental_variable
      )
    )
  
  venn_label_type <- ifelse(use_percentages, "percent", "count")
  
  # INITIALIZE LISTS with NULLs to ensure length consistency
  pos_plots <- vector("list", length(target_vars))
  neg_plots <- vector("list", length(target_vars))
  label_plots <- vector("list", length(target_vars))
  
  # Function to generate the Venn or a Zero-Venn
  render_venn <- function(input_list, f_color) {
    is_empty <- all(sapply(input_list, length) == 0)
    p <- suppressWarnings(
      ggVennDiagram(input_list, show_intersect = show_items, set_color = "black", label = venn_label_type) +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    )
    if (is_empty) {
      p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4FAFE", high = "#F4FAFE", guide = "none")
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4FAFE", high = f_color, guide = "none")
    }
    return(p)
  }

  # Loop through target_vars by index to prevent "subscript out of bounds"
  for (i in seq_along(target_vars)) {
    var <- target_vars[i]
    
    # Positive associations
    pos_lst <- venn_data_all %>% filter(direction == "Positive", variable_clean == var) %>% 
               group_by(atlas) %>% summarize(items = list(!!sym(item_column)), .groups = 'drop') %>% deframe()
    
    pos_input <- list("1970s" = pos_lst[["1"]] %||% character(0),
                      "1990s" = pos_lst[["2"]] %||% character(0),
                      "2010s" = pos_lst[["3"]] %||% character(0))
    
    # Negative associations
    neg_lst <- venn_data_all %>% filter(direction == "Negative", variable_clean == var) %>% 
               group_by(atlas) %>% summarize(items = list(!!sym(item_column)), .groups = 'drop') %>% deframe()
    
    neg_input <- list("1970s" = neg_lst[["1"]] %||% character(0),
                      "1990s" = neg_lst[["2"]] %||% character(0),
                      "2010s" = neg_lst[["3"]] %||% character(0))
    
    fill_color <- base_colors[[var]] %||% "grey50"
    
    # Store using indices
    pos_plots[[i]] <- render_venn(pos_input, fill_color)
    neg_plots[[i]] <- render_venn(neg_input, fill_color)
    label_plots[[i]] <- ggplot() + 
                        annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = var, size = 4, fontface = "bold") + 
                        theme_void()
  }
  
  # Now plot_grid is guaranteed to have the correct number of grobs
  pos_row <- plot_grid(plotlist = pos_plots, nrow = 1)
  label_row <- plot_grid(plotlist = label_plots, nrow = 1)
  neg_row <- plot_grid(plotlist = neg_plots, nrow = 1)
  
title_grob <- ggdraw() + 
    draw_label(plot_title, fontface = 'bold', size = 18, x = 0.5, y = 0.7) + 
    draw_label(plot_subtitle, size = 13, x = 0.5, y = 0.3, fontface = "italic", color = "grey30")

  main_plot <- plot_grid(pos_row, label_row, neg_row, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.05, 1))
  
  # Final stack: slightly more height (0.12) given to the title/subtitle area
  return(plot_grid(title_grob, main_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.12, 1)))
}
```

### TRAIT VENNS 
```{r,include = TRUE, echo = FALSE,fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
# --------- For TRAITS (Labels ON) --------- 
dir <- './HmscOutputs'
pattern <- '2026-02-10'

merged_traits <- make_gamma_sizes(dir, pattern)
na.omit(merged_traits)

# Clean traits up before passing to function
cleaned_traits_data <- merged_traits %>%
  mutate(clean_traits = traits %>% 
           str_remove_all("foraging_guild_consensus") %>% 
           str_remove_all("Migration_a3_DOF") %>% 
           str_trim())

# Define lists
list_1 <- c("Temperature", "Precipitation", "Land-use heterogeneity")
list_2 <- c("Urban", "Cropland", "Pasture", 
            "Forest", "Grass/Shrubland")

# Climate Plot
plot_1 <- plot_venn_grid(cleaned_traits_data, "clean_traits", list_1, 
                         plot_title = "Temporal consistency in species' characteristics' significant associations with climate/heterogeneity",
                         plot_subtitle = 'Positive associations (top-row) | Negative associations (bottom-row)',
                         use_percentages = FALSE,
                         show_items = FALSE)

# Land Use Plot
plot_2 <- plot_venn_grid(cleaned_traits_data, "clean_traits", list_2, 
                         plot_title = "Temporal consistency in species' characteristics' significant associations with land-use", 
                                                  plot_subtitle = 'Positive associations (top-row) | Negative associations (bottom-row)',
                         use_percentages = FALSE,
                         show_items = FALSE)
# View them
print(plot_1)
print(plot_2)

# --------- For SPECIES (Labels OFF) --------- 
merged_species <- make_beta_sizes(dir, pattern)

# Define lists
list_1 <- c("Temperature", "Precipitation", "Land-use heterogeneity")
list_2 <- c("Urban", "Cropland", "Pasture", 
            "Forest", "Grass/Shrubland")

# Climate Plot
plot_1 <- plot_venn_grid(merged_species, "species", list_1, 
                         plot_title = "Temporal consistency in species' significant associations with climate/heterogeneity", 
                         plot_subtitle = 'Positive associations (top-row) | Negative associations (bottom-row)',
                         use_percentages = FALSE,
                         show_items = FALSE)

# Land Use Plot
plot_2 <- plot_venn_grid(merged_species, "species", list_2, 
                         plot_title = "Temporal consistency in species' significant associations with land-use", 
                         plot_subtitle = 'Positive associations (top-row) | Negative associations (bottom-row)',
                         use_percentages = FALSE,
                         show_items = FALSE)
# View them
print(plot_1)
print(plot_2)
```
